justifications.unit: Unit tests (in Encina.UnitTests, compiled from the linked source file) drive the category-based validation and not-found assertions in their Either and Task overloads plus the shared helper; left uncovered are the success, collection, code, message, authorization, conflict and internal assertions, which are not changed by this fix.
justifications.guard: 0: the changed public methods take only an Either struct or a Task and have no validated reference or nullable parameters, so there is no argument guard for the guard flag to cover.
